description: Plan cancel intent: Python (analysis authority / Go opportunity lifecycle) asks the C# executor to withdraw a plan that must no longer trade. Consumed by algo-bot/tests/test_s14b_plan_cancel_contract.py and ctrader-engine/tests/TradePlanRuntimeTests.CancelIntent.cs so both sides are held to one table.

semantics.cancelled_unsubmitted: the plan never reached the broker; nothing was ever submitted
semantics.cancelled_pending_orders: every resting entry order was cancelled at the broker and no position ever opened
semantics.positions_kept_unfilled_cancelled: at least one leg is a real position and stays managed; only unfilled legs were withdrawn
semantics.positions_kept: every leg was already a position; nothing to withdraw, nothing closed
